blocks.title: <ico-recycle></ico-recycle> REPASO EXPRESS
blocks.intro: Antes de empezar, recupera lo de la clase pasada. Une cada palabra con su significado — sin mirar atrás.

blocks.title: <ico-hotel></ico-hotel> ACCOMMODATION & PROBLEMS
blocks.intro: Para registrarte y resolver problemas con tacto. Practica en voz alta, ¡sin traductor!

items.sp: la calefacción / el aire no funciona

blocks.stage: ① VOCAB & GRAMMAR · alojamiento + problemas + present perfect

cells.body:
I've been here for two days.
It hasn't worked since last night.

Has the taxi arrived yet?
It hasn't come yet.
hasn't worked since I arrived (sigue ahora) vs. It broke yesterday (tiempo terminado)

parts.body: Present perfect continuous: "I've been waiting at reception for 20 minutes." · Quejas educadas: "I'm afraid there's an issue with…", "Would it be possible to change rooms?"

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> A COLD ROOM
blocks.intro: Un huésped tiene un problema en el hotel. Primero practicas el present perfect, y luego escuchas 2 audios: una queja en recepción y un mensaje.
blocks.stage: ② THE STORY · en recepción

blocks.title: FOR or SINCE?

items.q: She's lived in this city ___ 2019.
They've known each other ___ ten years.
The Wi-Fi has been down ___ this morning.

speaking.prompt: Reporta 2 problemas de un hotel de forma educada, usando hasn't worked since… y I've already…

blocks.stage: ③ PRACTICE · elige la respuesta

blocks.title: PAST SIMPLE or PRESENT PERFECT?
blocks.intro: Tiempo terminado → pasado simple. Sigue ahora / reciente → present perfect.

items.q: I ___ in this hotel since Monday. (be)
The heater ___ two hours ago. (break)

blocks.title: ORDENA LA FRASE
blocks.intro: Toca las palabras para formar la frase correcta.

items.answer: The heating hasn't worked since last night
I have already tried it twice
Has my taxi been booked yet

blocks.title: PRESENT PERFECT vs PAST SIMPLE
blocks.intro: Las dos son correctas — pero una dice que el problema sigue ahora y la otra que ya terminó. En una queja, eso lo cambia todo.

pair.a: The heating hasn't worked since last night.
pair.b: The heating didn't work last night.

items.q: ¿Cuál dice que ahora mismo sigues sin calefacción?
¿Cuál suena a que ya se arregló?
Llevas dos días sin Wi-Fi y sigue sin andar. ¿Qué dices?
options: The Wi-Fi hasn't worked for two days.
The Wi-Fi doesn't work two days ago.
The Wi-Fi didn't work for two days.

items.q: Quieres decir que ya probaste el control dos veces. ¿Qué dices?
options: I already tried it twice yesterday.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · AT RECEPTION
blocks.desc: Un huésped reporta un problema. Fíjate en el problema y en desde cuándo.

questions.q: What's the problem, and since when?
options: There's no hot water since Monday evening
The heating hasn't worked since last night
The Wi-Fi hasn't worked since this morning

questions.q: Has the guest tried the control?
options: No, not yet — she will try it
No, reception will book it later

transcript.html: Hi, I'm in room 204. There's a problem — the heating hasn't worked since last night.
I'm sorry to hear that. Have you tried the control on the wall?
Yes, I've already tried it twice. And the room is really cold.
I understand. I'll send someone up right now.
Thank you. Also, has my morning taxi been booked yet?
Yes, it's just been confirmed for seven a.m.

blocks.stage: ④ LISTENING · escucha la queja

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · ROOM 305
blocks.desc: Un mensaje a recepción con dos problemas. Fíjate en desde cuándo y por qué.

questions.q: Since when has the person been at the hotel?

options: The room next door is being cleaned
The Wi-Fi hasn't worked since last night
There's no hot water in the bathroom
The bed is too small and hard
The heating is too cold at night
The room next door is noisy

transcript.html: Hello, this is room 305. I've been here since Monday, and I have two problems. First, the Wi-Fi hasn't worked since last night. Second, the room next door is very noisy, and I haven't slept well for two days. Could you help me, please?

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> A POLITE COMPLAINT
blocks.intro: Escribe un mensaje corto y educado a un hotel o anfitrión sobre un problema (5–6 oraciones), usando el present perfect con for/since y already/yet.
blocks.placeholder: Hello, I've been in room ... since ... There's a problem with...
blocks.example: Hello, I've been in room ___ since ___. There's a problem — the cosa hasn't participio since ___. I've already ___. Could you petición? Has ___ been done yet?
blocks.hw: Escribe tu mensaje y después grábate haciendo la queja en voz alta, sin leer — educado pero claro.
blocks.stage: ⑤ WRITING · en clase o tarea (HW)

rubric.d: Escribiste lo que pide la consigna, completo y en el formato pedido.
Usaste el present perfect con for/since/already/yet/just al menos 3 veces, y bien.
Se entiende sin releer: ideas unidas, sin traducir literal del español.
